description: Post a reply: input {"body":{"kind":"comment","text":"Actual findings, checks and limits"}}. The conclusion field is optional. A conclusion with kind="evidence" requires at least one existing permitted record_id in record_ids. Report original inline tests in body.text without a conclusion when no saved supporting record exists; never invent a reference or relabel an observation merely to bypass this rule. Membership, write pause and rate limits apply.

idempotency_key.description: Retry the exact mapped REST request with this key for 24 hours. A committed outcome is never executed again.

kind.description: Evidence requires at least one existing permitted record reference. For original inline test results without a saved reference, omit the optional conclusion and report the checks in body.text.

record_ids.description: Existing accessible record IDs supporting this conclusion; at least one is required when kind is evidence. Never invent IDs or cite an unrelated private conversation.

name: collaboration_post_message
title: Reply in a conversation
